reviews.author: Jewel Felder-James

reviews.text:
I love going to Mr. Lee auto body hes my new go to mechanic. He helped me when Mavis messed up my oil changed and almost damaged my engine. I thought he was going to charge me an arm and a leg but he was honest and showed how it was a minor problem ( just a screw)and fixed the issue fast. I just went and got my inspection done and Mr. Lee did my inspection fast and effective. I just needed three bulbs replaced which was fast and quick. As a female you have to be careful who you go to and I consider him honest. There a few things to know before you go:

1) If he can not fix the issue he will tell you to go to the dealership this can make people upset but like I said he's honest he's only going to work on what he can fix

2) He does not do appointments

3) If you want him to check your car get there at 8 AM if you come at 8:05 or 8:10 it's to late. He's very time sensitive because he is in high demand

4)Because he is reliable and knows what he's doing he is really in high demand so be patient.

I overall give Mr. Lee 5 stars across the board so try him out.
